name: Henry de Zoete
background: From March to August 2026 de Zoete was Investment and AI Adviser in the Department for Science, Innovation and Technology.

name: Hans Christian Holte
background: Holte was Director of Labour and Welfare from 2020 to 2025.

name: Lucilla Sioli
background: A European Commission civil servant since 1997, Sioli was listed in August 2020 as Director for Artificial Intelligence and Digital Industry in DG CONNECT.

name: Arvind Raman
role: Acting Director of the Center for AI Standards and Innovation (CAISI, the institute's former name)
background: Raman came to NIST from Purdue University, where Raman was named Dean of Engineering in February 2023, and is also NIST Director, sworn in on 30 June 2026.

role: Executive Director, Canadian AI Safety Institute
background: Dostal is also Senior Assistant Deputy Minister, Strategic Policy Sector, at ISED, a post held since September 2024, and earlier held posts at Fisheries and Oceans Canada, the Treasury Board Secretariat, Finance Canada and Global Affairs Canada.

role: Co-Director, Canadian AI Safety Institute Research Program (CAISI) at CIFAR
